section.title: Lifecycle Overview
section.p: FlowDesk uses a structured ticket lifecycle to ensure consistent tracking, accountability, and service transparency. Each ticket progresses through defined states that reflect operational activity from creation to closure.

row.entry: Ticket has been created and logged.
Ticket is allocated to a technician.
Active investigation or resolution is underway.
Work is temporarily paused awaiting external input.
Requires user feedback, approval, or dependency resolution.
Solution has been applied and validated.

section.title: Status Transitions
section.p: Tickets progress sequentially through lifecycle states, though controlled transitions allow reassignment or reopening when necessary. Transition permissions are governed by role policies to preserve accountability.

section.title: Operational Integrity
section.p: Maintaining accurate ticket status ensures reliable reporting, workload visibility, and service auditing. Teams are expected to update lifecycle states in alignment with actual operational progress.
